_doc: config/env-vars.<envkey>.json — per-target MAINTAINED environment-variable values (19-09, OI-1 option A / D-23).
<envkey> = the target env URL's first host label (https://org66725818.crm.dynamics.com -> org66725818), derived by deploy-solution.yml.
The committed deploymentSettings.skeleton.json DECLARES the solution's env-var SchemaNames (no values);
this file SUPPLIES the per-target Value for every declared SchemaName. gen-deployment-settings.sh merges
by SchemaName and FAILS THE JOB LOUDLY if any declared SchemaName is missing or empty here — no silent skips.
Values are NEVER copied from the source environment (D-23): maintain them here, per target, PR-reviewed.
Entries not declared by the skeleton are ignored with a notice. `_doc` keys are documentation only (ignored by the merge).
SECRET-TYPE / KEY VAULT env vars (D-23/D-21): commit the Key Vault REFERENCE ONLY — NEVER the raw secret.
The raw secret stays in Azure Key Vault and is resolved by Power Platform IN THE TARGET environment;
it never enters this repo, GitHub secrets, or the dispatch payload. A reference is not a secret — committing it is safe.
A raw secret value anywhere in a committed env-vars file is a defect (threat T-19-31) — fix the leak and rotate the secret.
